title: Sports Illustrated March 25, 1985 Peter Ueberroth- Willie Mays- Mickey Mantle
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Vintage Sports Memorabilia:Publications:Magazines
descriptionText: The product is a vintage Sports Illustrated magazine from March 25, 1985 featuring baseball legends Mickey Mantle and Willie Mays. The magazine is an original edition, ungraded, and was manufactured in the United States. It is focused on the New York Yankees team, making it a valuable piece of sports memorabilia for fans of baseball history and vintage publications.
